name: dsh-adapter
description: Runs an unmodified DeepSeek Harness plugin in its own process and contributes the plugin's projected view to a member, through the contribution protocol.
author: kirocrew
useCases: Show a foreign plugin's projected view on a member's card without porting the plugin or running its code inside the gateway.
configuration: Write data/config.json in the app directory with checkout (the plugin checkout path), gateway, token, and optionally units.
